offers_products.reason: Online marketplace platform and dealer software tools like listings, pricing and digital retail are core offerings.

offers_services.reason: Dealers pay for marketing and listing services; consumers get car-selling offers, financing and shopping help.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Car shoppers and sellers use the site to buy, sell, finance and get offers on cars.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Tens of thousands of dealers pay for listings, marketing and sourcing and selling tools.

recurring_revenue.reason: Dealer subscriptions for marketplace listings and advertising are paid on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Dealers can cut advertising and listing spend in a downturn, and car transactions slow.

big_ticket.reason: Dealers pay small, frequent monthly subscription fees, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from the website, data and software platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are car dealerships, many of them independent, plus individual consumers.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light online platform; growth needs software and marketing, not plants or fleets.

notes: Revenue mix is judged from general knowledge: dealer subscriptions are likely the larger part, with wholesale and retail vehicle sales smaller.
